movie.title: Don't Move
movie.overview: A church group's annual retreat turns deadly when they wander into the wrong part of the Ozark wilderness, and something starts picking them off one by one.  Suspicion falls on Ricky, the troublemaker of the group. But the real threat is far worse.  Deep in the forest, wrapped in a labyrinth of webs, the group is pursued by a terrifying prehistoric arachnid that hunts by vibration. When every step could be their last, they only have one choice: Don't Move.  It's up to Megan to hold what's left of the group together and get them out alive.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: During a church retreat in the Ozark wilderness, a group must survive a relentless prehistoric spider that hunts by tracking vibration.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: An annual church group retreat turns into a fight for survival when the attendees wander into a secluded section of the Ozark forest. Suspicion initially falls on Ricky, the group's troublemaker, but the true menace is a massive, web-weaving prehistoric arachnid. To avoid becoming its next meal, the survivors must remain completely still while finding a way to safety. Led by Megan, the remaining members must overcome internal tension and outsmart a monster that detects the slightest movement.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: The annual wilderness retreat for a close-knit church group takes a tragic turn after they stray deep into an uncharted zone of the Ozark mountains. As members of the group begin disappearing or turning up dead, tension rises, and suspicion quickly shifts toward Ricky, a rebellious outcast with a bad reputation. However, the true predator hiding in the dense forest is far more terrifying: a giant, ancient arachnid that has spun a lethal labyrinth of webs across the canopy. The creature possesses terrifying instincts, relying entirely on vibration to track and capture its prey. Realizing that making a sound or stepping out of line triggers an instant attack, the group is forced into a deadly game of stealth where their only defense is to stay motionless. Internal conflicts and panicked missteps continually threaten to expose their location to the lurking monster. Amidst the chaos, Megan steps up to lead the terrified survivors, striving to maintain order and keep everyone calm under extreme duress. She must navigate the trap-laden woods and outwit a creature that turns their own reflexes against them. Ultimately, Megan and the survivors must unite and execute a desperate escape plan before the spider picks them off one by one.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Set against the dense, isolated backdrop of the Ozark wilderness, 'Don't Move' follows a church group whose routine annual retreat dissolves into a harrowing nightmare. After venturing off the beaten path, the group finds themselves hunted by a predatory prehistoric arachnid that uses sensitive vibration detection to stalk its prey. As paranoia mounts and accusations fly toward the group's resident troublemaker, Megan must keep the panic-stricken survivors focused on a singular, grueling rule of survival: freeze. Blending psychological dread with creature-feature suspense, the film explores leadership, trust, and nerve-shredding tension as the characters fight to escape an ancient threat.

story_structure.climax: Megan and the remaining group members face a desperate, high-stakes confrontation with the monster, where absolute stillness and careful strategy are their only chance at survival.
story_structure.conflict: Members of the group begin disappearing one by one, raising immediate tension and causing suspicion to fall directly on Ricky while the true threat remains hidden.
story_structure.resolution: The ordeal comes to a end as the survivors attempt to break free from the creature's labyrinth and escape the Ozark wilderness.
story_structure.introduction: A church group travels into a remote section of the Ozark wilderness for their annual retreat, establishing the setting, group dynamic, and Ricky's reputation as the group troublemaker.
story_structure.risingAction: The survivors discover they are trapped in webbed territory, stalked by an ancient, predatory arachnid that hunts through vibration, forcing Megan to step up, maintain order, and navigate the team through a lethal environment where any movement triggers an attack.
